title: Big picture, round 4: popups, Foundations structure, map + lists

steps.path: Big picture → any view → click an item
steps.headline: Details open in a large centred popup instead of a side panel.
steps.changed: The popup follows the app's detail-page layout: titled by kind ("Feature details"), a top card with the name, its status and its place in the plan, then two columns of labelled cards: what you see (its screens, the work on them) on the left, how it connects on the right.
steps.notice: Clicking a connected item inside the popup swaps to it; a back arrow appears at the top left. A screenshot opens on top of the popup, and closing it returns here.
steps.risk: The popup covers the page, so you can't see the list behind while reading details.

steps.path: Big picture → Foundations, as it opens
steps.headline: Foundations: a one-sentence summary, then "Build these first" as folded rows.
steps.changed: A summary card says how many linked things are unbuilt, how many could start now, and how many the top five would unblock. The top five are folded rows; the rest of the lists are below, renamed "Could start now", "Waiting on something", "Already built".
steps.notice: The answer to "what should be built next" is still the first thing you read, now with the reason in one sentence above it.

steps.path: Big picture → Foundations, the first item opened
steps.headline: Opening one shows what it frees up, in words.
steps.changed: Under "Once it exists, these can move": each thing that needs it directly, with what else it still waits on, or "Nothing else missing: it could start next". Then how many more sit further up, and a button for its full details.
steps.notice: Round 3 said "unblocks 13"; now you see which ones.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works, as it opens
steps.headline: How it works, a hybrid: the map is back on top, lists below.
steps.changed: Round 2's boxes and lines, redrawn in the app's look: each part a box with its status, a line per connection, faint where not built. Below it, the paths and the parts as folded rows, as in round 3.
steps.risk: The map has no detail of its own; it points into the rows below. If you would rather have two separate views (map / list), say so.
steps.notice: You see the whole shape at a glance again, without the round 2 clutter beside it.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works → open "Follow a message"
steps.headline: Opening a path lights its route on the map.
steps.changed: Opening "Follow a message" darkens the lines and boxes it passes through and fades the rest. Its steps are listed right under the map.
steps.notice: Close the path and the map goes back to normal. With two ways open (Claude Code and YouCoded's engine), both routes light.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works → click the Sync box on the map
steps.headline: Clicking a box on the map opens that part's row below.
steps.changed: The page jumps to the part and opens it: what it is made of, what it talks to, and the ideas that rest on it (click one for its popup).
steps.risk: The jump is instant; there is no animation back up to the map.
steps.notice: The map and the lists are one thing: every box leads to its row.
